# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Age:** 10 to 11 years old in Volume 1  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** School student  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Opal possesses lovely skin, curly brown hair, and stylishly arranged hairstyles. She is a pupil at Brierley school who attends class dressed in bright clothes with puffed sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c11 P29](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0029), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

Opal is a lively schoolgirl who is prone to bouts of tears and hysteria under stress or excitement. She is easily spooked by strict authority or sudden classroom incidents. She pays close attention to romantic gossip and the behavior of her teachers and peers.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c15 P66](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0066)_

## Traits

- Lively and dramatic  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c15 P66](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0066)</sub>
- Prone to tears and hysteria  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c15 P66](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0066)</sub>
- Attentive to romantic gossip  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>

## Abilities

- Capable of spotting hidden classroom behaviors  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>

## Goals

- Attending Brierley school and pursuing her studies  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>

## History

Opal attends Brierley school alongside Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke. She becomes known among the pupils for monitoring teacher Mr. Pidgeon's romantic interest in older student Sukey Pullen. During one afternoon class, she collapses back onto her chair with a faint scream and begins weeping when Hugh Carrow secretly attaches her long blonde plait to the back of her seat. On a subsequent occasion when pupils arrive late after gathering spruce gum, she becomes terribly pale with fear and later recounts to her peers how white Nell turned when forced to sit next to Hugh Carrow as a punishment. She also lends an apple to Nell during her first day at school.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P66](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0066)_
